items.stem: Explain your reasoning in each part. (a) Explain how to find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining two given points. (b) Explain why every point on the perpendicular bisector of AB is the same distance from A as from B.
items.answer: (a) Find the midpoint, find the gradient of the segment, take the negative reciprocal, and use y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) through the midpoint. (b) For a point P on it, the triangles PMA and PMB (M the midpoint) are congruent: PM common, MA = MB, right angles at M. So PA = PB.
items.markingKey: (a) B1 midpoint and negative reciprocal gradient; B1 line equation through midpoint [2] (b) B1 congruent triangles / Pythagoras with MA = MB; B1 PA = PB [2]
